decisions.reason: The abstract states that Golden Retriever dogs with a frameshift variant in CLN5 suffer from a neurodegenerative disorder analogous to CLN5 form of NCL. The frameshift variant (mutation) in CLN5 gene causes the disease. The surrounding context establishes the causal relationship between the CLN5 mutation and the CLN5 disease phenotype.
